title: Sufficiently Regularized Nonnegative Quartic Polynomials are Sum-of-Squares
summary: A polynomial that is nonnegative need not be a sum of squares of polynomials. This classical gap, identified by Hilbert in 1888, lies at the heart of why the global optimization of multivariate quartic polynomials is NP-hard. Yet we show that this gap is closed when using (sufficient) regularization, which fundamentally alters the algebraic structure of the problem. Namely, we investigate a class of quartically-regularized cubic polynomials which arise naturally in polynomial optimization and higher-order tensor methods for nonconvex problems.
